name: SearchPlaces
title: Search Places
description: Find local businesses and places with ratings via SearchAPI.io (Google Maps)
whenToUse: Pick to find local BUSINESSES or PLACES: each result carries address, rating, review count, phone, website and GPS coordinates (Google Maps). Use it when you need structured place or location data; it returns places, not arbitrary web pages, dated articles, or videos.

outputs.name: placeResults
outputs.description: Place results (title, address, rating, reviews, type, phone, website, coordinates)

query.title: Search Query
query.description: What to search for on Maps, e.g. 'coffee shops', 'dentist'

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional coordinate filter, SearchAPI 'll' format e.g. '@40.7009973,-73.994778,12z'. Leave blank to infer from the query.

numResults.title: Number of Results
numResults.description: Number of place results to return

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: search
package.packageFile:
# FULLY DECLARATIVE. Four nodes, one endpoint, one key.
#
# SearchAPI.io is the cleanest case for this format: every engine is the SAME url switched
# by `engine=`, authenticated by one `api_key` in the query. `shared/searchapi.yaml` holds
# the call, each node names its engine and shapes its own reply, and the whole client is
# gone: `auth: apiKeyQuery` was already an executor capability.
#
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/search/`.

name: search
displayName: Search
description: Web, news, video and places search via SearchAPI.io
version: 2.0.0
category: search
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/3128/3128287.png

features:
  - Google web and image results
  - Google News, dated articles
  - YouTube video search
  - Google Maps places with ratings

allowedHosts:
  - www.searchapi.io

requires:
  credential: [apiKeyQuery]
  transport: [json]
  executorVersion: ">=1.0.0"

credentials.searchapiCredential.yaml:
# One key powers every engine in this package. Transcribed from src/credentials/index.ts.

name: searchapiCredential
displayName: SearchAPI
description: SearchAPI.io credentials. One key powers every search engine in this package.
documentationUrl: https://www.searchapi.io/docs

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your SearchAPI.io API key
    placeholder: ""

shared.searchapi.yaml:
# The ONE call every node in this package makes.
#
# Same url, same auth, switched by `engine`. A node $refs this and layers its own `query`
# keys on top, which is what a $ref with siblings does: imported first, local wins.
#
# The key travels as a query parameter because that is what the vendor takes. `apiKeyQuery`
# is an executor capability, so no node handles a secret itself.

call: &call
  method: GET
  url: https://www.searchapi.io/api/v1/search
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyQuery
    param: api_key
    value: "{{ credentials.searchapiCredential.apiKey }}"
  headers:
    Accept: application/json
  transport: json
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]

# A 200 is not always a success here: the vendor reports a bad parameter or an exhausted
# quota in the body. Without this a failed search emits empty results and reads as "nothing
# found", which is the wrong answer rather than an error.
error: &error
  when: "return !!response.error"
  message: "return typeof response.error === 'string' ? response.error : JSON.stringify(response.error)"

files.api/events.yaml:
- emit: placeResults
  from: response
  # `type` is a single string on some results and a `types` array on others.
  value: >-
    return (response.local_results || []).slice(0, config.numResults).map(p => ({
      title: p.title || "",
      address: p.address || "",
      rating: typeof p.rating === "number" ? p.rating : null,
      reviews: typeof p.reviews === "number" ? p.reviews : null,
      type: p.type || (Array.isArray(p.types) ? p.types[0] : "") || "",
      phone: p.phone || "",
      website: p.website || "",
      gpsCoordinates: p.gps_coordinates
        ? { latitude: p.gps_coordinates.latitude, longitude: p.gps_coordinates.longitude }
        : null,
      placeId: p.place_id || ""
    }))
files.api/run.yaml:
# `ll` is omitted when blank rather than sent empty: the executor drops a key whose template
# resolved to nothing, and Maps then infers a region from the query.

- $ref: searchapi#call
  name: search
  error: { $ref: searchapi#error }
  query:
    engine: google_maps
    q: "{{ config.query }}"
    ll: "{{ config.location }}"
    hl: "{{ config.language }}"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [query]
  properties:
    query:
      type: string
      title: Search Query
      description: What to search for on Maps, e.g. 'coffee shops', 'dentist'
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    location:
      type: string
      title: Location
      description: >-
        Optional coordinate filter, SearchAPI 'll' format e.g. '@40.7009973,-73.994778,12z'.
        Leave blank to infer from the query.
      default: ""
    numResults:
      type: number
      title: Number of Results
      description: Number of place results to return
      default: 20
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 100
    language:
      type: string
      title: Language
      description: Language code for results, e.g. 'en', 'ar'
      default: en
"ui:order": [query, location, numResults, language]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: query
    type: string
    description: Search query, e.g. 'coffee shops'
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: placeResults
    type: array
    description: Place results (title, address, rating, reviews, type, phone, website, coordinates)

credentials:
  - name: searchapiCredential
    required: true
    displayName: SearchAPI
files.node.yaml:
type: SearchPlaces
kind: PromiseNode
name: Search Places
category: Search
color: "#34A853"
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/684/684908.png
description: Find local businesses and places with ratings via SearchAPI.io (Google Maps)
whenToUse: >
  Pick to find local BUSINESSES or PLACES: each result carries address, rating, review
  count, phone, website and GPS coordinates (Google Maps). Use it when you need structured
  place or location data; it returns places, not arbitrary web pages, dated articles, or
  videos.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (DECLARATIVE_NODES.md §9.13). Compulsory on every node, so that a node
# nobody thought about cannot look the same as one deliberately left open.
#
# `required: false` adds no requirement of its own: the node runs for whoever the trigger
# admitted. The trigger instance's publicEntry toggle still owns the door, and requirements
# only ever narrow.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  cacheable: true
files.test.yaml:
testData:
  config:
    query: coffee shops in Shoreditch London
    location: ""
    numResults: 10
    language: en
  inputs:
    query: coffee shops in Shoreditch London
  expect:
    placeResults: "return output.placeResults.length > 0 && typeof output.placeResults[0].title === 'string'"
